description.value: Jing Tan Grill House is an upscale Chinese BBQ restaurant in Richmond specializing in premium grilled meats, from wagyu beef and lamb racks to foie gras and seafood, with an all-you-can-eat option. The restaurant is known for its distinctive interior décor and a theatrical 'ferris wheel' meat-presentation feature that has drawn enthusiastic reviews. It operates as a full sit-down dining experience in a strip-mall unit near Minoru Boulevard.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: rack at 25m; rack at 45m; rack (covered) at 45m; rack at 49m; rack at 59m; rack at 59m; stands (covered) at 64m; rack at 95m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active, features a full menu, reservation system, and an 'Online Order' navigation link, confirming the business is open and that takeout/online ordering is available. The website confirms and expands the OSM address to '5960 Minoru Blvd #140, Richmond, BC V6X 3J3' and provides a phone number absent from OSM; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. Minor inconsistencies in how the restaurant name is spelled within the website body text were noted.
concerns: Phone number (778) 789-9919 found on website but is absent from OSM tags — worth adding to OSM.
Website body text spells the name inconsistently: 'Jingtan Grill House' and 'Jingtang Grill House' appear alongside the correct 'Jing Tan Grill House'; OSM name is used as authoritative.

Website contains unfilled placeholder 'Lorem ipsum' text in the Main Course, Drinks, and Desserts section descriptions, and the stats counters display zero values (seats, menus, years experience), indicating an incompletely configured site template.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating full-service restaurant with an active website, online ordering, and table reservations. A straightforward inclusion as a dining option for touring cyclists in Richmond.

wow_evidence: theatrical 'ferris wheel' meat-presentation feature that has drawn enthusiastic reviews
